CapabilityObservation.description: CapabilityObservation keeps a measured zero distinct from a missing value.

available.description: True only when value, year, source and unit passed the server contract.

source.description: Provider or dataset attribution stored with the observation.

value.description: Numeric observation. Read available first: zero is also the proto3 placeholder.

year.description: Observation year from the source, not the seed run year.

DemographicsCapabilityStage.description: Independent fetch-stage state. One failed stage must not hide healthy groups.

fetchedAt.description: ISO-8601 time of the data retained for this stage.

name.description: Stable stage name: wpp, education, or ilostat.

newestObservationYear.description: Most recent source observation year retained for the stage.

recordCount.description: Number of country records retained for the stage.

status.description: Seeder state, normally fresh, retained, or unavailable.

lastObservedAtMs.description:
Unix milliseconds when the oldest constituent signal in this
 dimension was last observed (min fetchedAt across INDICATOR_REGISTRY
 entries for this dimension). 0 when no signal has ever been
 observed.

staleness.description:
Worst staleness level across the dimension's constituent signals,
 classified by classifyStaleness against each signal's cadence.
 One of: "fresh", "aging", "stale". Empty string when no signals.

Error.description: Error is returned when a handler encounters an error. It contains a simple error message that the developer can customize.

message.description: Error message (e.g., 'user not found', 'database connection failed')

FieldViolation.description: FieldViolation describes a single validation error for a specific field.

description.description: Human-readable description of the validation violation (e.g., 'must be a valid email address', 'required field missing')

field.description: The field path that failed validation (e.g., 'user.email' for nested fields). For header validation, this will be the header name (e.g., 'X-API-Key')

FoodStockRecord.description: One country (or WORLD) × commodity production/stocks balance from the seeded snapshot.

commodity.description: Commodity slug: wheat, corn, rice, soybeans, barley, palmOil.

consumptionTmt.description: Domestic consumption in thousand metric tons. Zero when unknown.

countryCode.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, or "WORLD" for the global balance sheet.

endingStocksTmt.description:
Ending stocks in thousand metric tons. Read has_ending_stocks first, for
 the same reason as stocks_to_use above.

exportsTmt.description: Exports in thousand metric tons. Zero when unknown.

hasEndingStocks.description: False when ending_stocks_tmt is a placeholder rather than a measurement.

hasStocksToUse.description: False when stocks_to_use is a placeholder rather than a measurement.

importsTmt.description: Imports in thousand metric tons. Zero when unknown.

marketingYear.description: Marketing year label stored verbatim, e.g. "2025/26". Never a calendar year.

productionTmt.description: Production in thousand metric tons. Zero when unknown.

source.description: Provenance: "psd" or "faostat". FAOSTAT rows never carry stocks.

stocksToUse.description:
Ending stocks divided by total use (0.18 = 18%). Read has_stocks_to_use
 BEFORE this value: proto3 has no presence for a bare double, so an unknown
 ratio and a genuine 0% are the same wire value. USDA/PSD estimates ending
 stocks only for selected countries, so a minor producer routinely reports
 real production and consumption with no stocks series at all — and 0.0% on
 a food-security surface reads as famine, not as "not measured".

totalUseTmt.description: Total use (consumption + exports) in thousand metric tons.

unit.description: Unit the raw quantities are stored in, typically "1000 MT".

available.description: True when at least one validated observation exists for the country.

fetchedAt.description: ISO-8601 time the canonical snapshot was generated.

GetFoodStocksRequest.description: GetFoodStocksRequest filters the seeded USDA-style food-stocks snapshot.

commodity.description: Commodity slug (wheat, corn, rice, soybeans, barley, palmOil). Empty = all.

countryCode.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, or WORLD. Empty returns the unfiltered snapshot.

GetFoodStocksResponse.description: GetFoodStocksResponse is the filtered seed snapshot.

calorieWeightedStocksToUse.description: Calorie-weighted stocks-to-use for the requested country, or 0 when unknown / unfiltered.

fetchedAt.description: ISO-8601 time the seeder wrote resilience:food-stocks:v1. Empty when unavailable.

unavailable.description: True when the seed is missing or unreadable (not a confirmed zero).

countryCode.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code to score.

headlineEligible.description:
Current headline-ranking eligibility. True only when the country passes
 the headline gate: coverage >= 0.65 AND (population >= 200k OR
 coverage >= 0.85) AND !lowConfidence. GetResilienceRanking includes
 only eligible countries in items[]; scored but ineligible countries
 remain in greyedOut[]. Raw score endpoints still return the country
 score when available. Widget and country detail copy should show
 "Outside headline ranking" when false unless low-confidence is the more
 specific reason.

schemaVersion.description:
Phase 2 T2.1/T2.3: "2.0" is the current default (adds pillars; keeps
 overall_score / baseline_score / etc. populated for backward compat).
 "1.0" is the legacy opt-out shape (pillars empty) retained for one
 release cycle. Controlled at response build time by the
 RESILIENCE_SCHEMA_V2_ENABLED env flag (defaults to "true" → v2).

imputationClass.description:
Four-class imputation taxonomy (Phase 1 T1.7). One of:
 "stable-absence", "unmonitored", "source-failure", "not-applicable".
 Empty string when the dimension has any observed data AND is not
 structurally not-applicable. The "not-applicable" value (plan
 2026-04-26-001 §U3) is emitted when the dim's construct does not
 apply to this country (e.g. sovereignFiscalBuffer for non-SWF
 economies); it is paired with coverage:0 and observed_weight:0 so
 the dim contributes nothing to the domain mean and is filtered
 out of user-facing confidence/coverage signals on both server and
 client. See docs/methodology/country-resilience-index.mdx.

ResiliencePillar.description:
Phase 2 T2.1/T2.3 of the country-resilience reference-grade upgrade plan.
 Three-pillar response shape that regroups the 6 ResilienceDomains
 (economic, infrastructure, energy, social-governance, health-food,
 recovery) into long-run capacity (structural-readiness), current shock
 pressure (live-shock-exposure), and recovery capability (recovery-capacity).
 Pillar scores are real domain-weighted, coverage-scaled aggregates computed
 from the constituent domains; pillar coverage remains the mean of
 member-domain average dimension coverage. See _pillar-membership.ts for the mapping.
 When RESILIENCE_SCHEMA_V2_ENABLED and RESILIENCE_PILLAR_COMBINE_ENABLED
 are both true, the top-level overall_score on GetResilienceScoreResponse
 uses the pillar-combined score with the min-pillar penalty term in
 _shared.ts#penalizedPillarScore. The legacy six-domain weighted aggregate
 remains the flag-off rollback path.

coverage.description: Coverage in [0, 1], mean of member-domain average dimension coverage.

score.description:
Pillar score in [0, 100], mean of member domains weighted by
 domain.weight * average_dimension_coverage.

weight.description: Pillar weight in the pillar-combined score. Per the plan: 0.40 / 0.35 / 0.25.

headlineEligible.description:
Current headline-ranking eligibility. True only when the country passes
 the headline gate: coverage >= 0.65 AND (population >= 200k OR
 coverage >= 0.85) AND !lowConfidence. GetResilienceRanking includes
 only eligible countries in items[]; scored but ineligible countries
 remain in greyedOut[].

education.description: Safe derived education construct version. Valid values: "active" or "rollback".

energy.description: Safe derived energy construct version. Valid values: "legacy" or "v2".

available.description:
True only when the public sample interval matches the active formula,
 education construct version, and interval methodology.

lastObservedAt.description: Latest safe observed timestamp from interval seed-meta or sample payload.

methodology.description: Public methodology tag used to audit scoreInterval/rankStable semantics.

sampleCountry.description: ISO2 country used for the public availability probe.

ValidationError.description: ValidationError is returned when request validation fails. It contains a list of field violations describing what went wrong.
